class.name: HeightmapTerrain3D
class.brief_description: A heightfield terrain node with sculpting and vertex-color painting.
class.description: HeightmapTerrain3D generates a mesh from a rectangular grid of height values. It is an initial native terrain authoring implementation for modest landscapes, not a streaming terrain system. A single surface is regenerated when data changes, with a maximum grid size of 257 by 257 vertices. The terrain origin is its top-left grid corner. X and Z are horizontal, Y is height. Heightfield vertices are spaced by [member cell_size] in local units. Each grid cell has one height and one vertex color. To edit in the 3D viewport, select the node and choose Raise, Lower, Smooth, or Paint Color from the terrain toolbar. The toolbar provides a brush radius in grid cells and a brush strength. Brush strokes participate in Undo/Redo. Heights and vertex colors are stored with the scene; the generated mesh is not independently serialized. The default surface material displays vertex colors, and can be overridden through the inherited material override. [b]Limitations:[/b] There is no LOD, chunk streaming, automatic collision updates, foliage system, texture splatmap, or advanced erosion in this initial implementation. Each edit currently regenerates the full mesh. For very large worlds, split the terrain into several nodes until chunked streaming is implemented.

method.name: create_collision_shape
method.description: Creates a collision shape snapshot from the terrain mesh. When heights change, regenerate the collision shape and assign it to your [CollisionShape3D] child. This requires 3D physics support.

method.name: erode_thermal
method.description: Redistributes excess height to four downhill neighbors by thermal erosion. A talus threshold can prevent flow on gentle slopes. Uses 0–128 iterations and strength from 0 to 1.

method.name: get_height_at
method.description: Returns the exact height sample at integer grid coordinates.

method.name: set_height_at
method.description: Sets the height at one vertex, then rebuilds the mesh.

method.name: sample_height
method.description: Bilinearly samples the surface at a fractional grid coordinate.

method.name: sculpt
method.description: Raises or lowers nearby vertices with quadratic falloff. Radius is in grid cells, delta is a height change in local Y units.

method.name: smooth
method.description: Blends local heights toward a 3 by 3 neighborhood average using a snapshot to avoid update-order bias.

method.name: paint_color
method.description: Paints vertex colors with radial falloff. This is vertex-color tinting, not four-layer terrain texture painting.

method.name: import_heightmap
method.description: Replaces the terrain with heights sampled from the image's grayscale luminance. Compressed images and grids larger than 257 by 257 are rejected.

members.member: Number of vertices along X and Z. Both dimensions must be between 2 and 257. Changing the size resets existing height and color data.
Horizontal spacing between vertices in local coordinate units.
Serialized row-major height values. Must contain [code]grid_size.x * grid_size.y[/code] finite values.
Serialized row-major vertex colors, one color per height sample.
